newsitem.title: USA: Hicks, Muse and Mandeville acquire Argentina cable.
newsitem.headline: Hicks, Muse and Mandeville acquire Argentina cable.

text.p: Investment firm Hicks, Muse, Tate & Furst Inc. and merchant bank Mandeville Partners said Monday they had bought five cable television systems in Argentina in a partnership with local business leaders.
The firms said the acquisitions of the systems in the towns of Necochea, Olavarria, Tandil, Salta and Posadas with a total of 115,000 subscribers were together worth about $100 million.

Dallas-based Hicks, Muse and Los Angeles-based merchant banking firm Mandeville Partners said the partnership with business leaders Julio Cesar Gutierrez and Julio Baqueriza, to be known as Mandeville Cable Partners Argentina, would acquire, develop and operate hardwire and wireless cable television systems in the country.
"The five systems (partnership) MCPA has acquired will be an excellent platform for future add-on acquisitions," they said.

The firms said Gutierrez was a selling shareholder of the systems in Necochea and Tandil, while Baqueriza was a selling shareholder of the Tandil system. Both of them will remain to operate the partnership and act as co-investors, they added.
